title: Médico cardiologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico cardiologista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO CARDIOLOGISTA (desejável RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\" Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ; ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Cardiologia.

title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists
We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll build
The voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring
3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. Requirements
Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different
At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Médico pediatra (rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico pediatra (rqe) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\" Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria. Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde. Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

Company Description Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. What you will work on Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership Our Technical Stack Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client Python - scripting, tooling Apache Tomcat - servlet container Java Servlets - HTTP request handling Postgre SQL + Hibernate g RPC AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too What we are looking for We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists
We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll build
The voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring
3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. Requirements
Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different
At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

About the Company Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp's diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company's mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries. About the Role The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams. Responsibilities Program & Project Delivery Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations. Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control. Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions. Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance. Vendor & MSP Management Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services. Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs. Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors. Cross-Functional Coordination Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines. Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs. Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met. Delivery Governance & Compliance Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers. Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce). Reporting & Metrics Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations. Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics. Qualifications 8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments. Experience working with or within hyperscalers. Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations. Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds. Proficiency with PM tools. Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills. Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks. Preferred Skills PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications. Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement. Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

description:

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world's most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that's just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes: New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry. Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base. Responsibilities Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures. Improve existing core backend services written in Node JS Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes Requirements At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs. Familiar with microservices architecture Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform Good experience in interacting with databases (My SQL, Mongo DB) Ability to quickly learn new technologies Good understanding of security practices Preferred skills Experience with blockchain integration Comfortable with high-availability concepts Ruby and Rails experience Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter's identity. All our recruiters have verified Linked In profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. title: Talent acquisition specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent acquisition specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist About Us: We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it's grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions The Role: We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you're excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds. What You'll Do: Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client's mission Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes What we are looking for: Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing Who You Are: Someone who is not satisfied with "just good enough" and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way Fluent in English and Portuguese Are You Still Curious? If you've read this far, then chances are you've got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can't wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We've intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work. At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive. We're now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You'll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support. What You'll Do Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close. Maintain accurate financial data using Quick Books or other cloud-based accounting tools. Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions. Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace. Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines. Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency. Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core's quality expectations. What We're Looking For Fluent in English Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time) Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools. Nice to Have Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana Prior experience working with startups or small businesses Why You'll Love Working With Us At Aerial Core, we do things differently: Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload. Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we'll support it. Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success. Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You'll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained. The Aerial Core Way Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value. Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights. Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth. Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care. Ready to do accounting differently? Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Senior it technical recruiter – latam based
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior it technical recruiter – latam based em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aptonet Inc. is seeking experienced Senior IT Technical Recruiters to join our world-class recruiting team. This role is based in Latin America (LATAM) and will focus on sourcing, screening, and placing top technical talent. You will recruit LATAM-based candidates for U. S.-based companies and also support U. S.-based recruiting efforts for our U. S. clients. Our recruiting team builds the foundation of our clients' success by connecting them with extraordinary talent who share our vision and values. What We Look For 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in an agency setting or a high-growth tech environment. Proven experience recruiting for diverse Information Technology roles. Understanding of technology trends and a passion for working with technical professionals. Strong ability to multi-task, manage multiple roles, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus. High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer service focus. Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and modern ATS systems. What You'll Be Doing Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, interviews, feedback, offers, and onboarding. Build strong pipelines of both LATAM and U. S.-based technical candidates using creative sourcing strategies. Leverage a variety of sourcing tools, including internet research, Boolean search strings, Linked In, ATS mining, and cold calling. Evaluate applicants by comparing qualifications to job requirements and conducting initial screening interviews. Post job advertisements across relevant platforms such as Linked In, Dice, Career Builder, and niche tech sites. Partner closely with hiring managers and internal teams to understand role requirements and deliver top candidates quickly. Maintain data accuracy in the ATS and track recruiting metrics for reporting and continuous improvement. Develop scalable recruiting processes to support the growth of our recruiting operations in LATAM and the U. S. Act as a trusted representative of Aptonet, promoting our values and delivering a high-quality experience to both candidates and clients.
